description: Train a continuous IQ velocity field from blind posterior to paired clean source IQ with time, dynamic channel backprojection and frozen ground F supervision; fixed 1/4/8-step source evaluation.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256]; parent posterior, current transport state, estimated-channel backprojection, estimated log noise, flow time
data.tx_sets_ref: L_s fit ID labels only for source supervised loss; U_s clean-F soft outputs only, never U_s true labels, V or test

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

dimensions: six RX8 source heldout scenes; raw, parent, DURA, 1/4/8 transport steps
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Only L_s fit truth used for supervised source loss; U_s clean-F soft distributions; evaluate pseudo labels not test truth; source physical IDs previously observed.

rows.method: conditional continuous IQ transport using frozen blind posterior and dynamic estimated-channel backprojection
rows.purpose: assess iterative learned recovery path with source fidelity and frozen ground F
rows.seed_notes: 4096 source fit IDs excluding 8192 prior IDs; source fit and shuffle seed 2026121455, model and transport time seed 2026121454
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: New architecture uses estimated channel backprojection at each Euler step; flow matching interpolation uses clean source only during training; neither DURA nor labels are used at inference. Pilot initiated after earlier source and Phase1 development tests were observed.
